title: Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Table — Violation Points of a Reported Resident Listed Before Exclusion
content:
**Violation-points relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a violation-points relativity multiplies the listing share of a household resident listed on the Owner Auto Policy before exclusion. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The points are the driver violation points recorded on the resident's most recent entry on the term. When two entries share that date, the one entered first is taken.

| Driver violation points on that entry | Relativity |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 1.3 |
| at least 5 and fewer than 10 | 1.12 |
| fewer than 5 | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Threshold sides (hypothetical).**

| Points | Relativity |
|---|---|
| 4 | 1 |
| 5 | 1.12 |
| 9 | 1.12 |
| 10 | 1.3 |
